verdict.rationale: Earth Class Mail documents AI summaries, automatic labels, and categorization of incoming scanned mail to help users 'stay on top of' it, plus junk filtering so you can 'focus on the mail that matters.' That is the product's own mechanism that could surface important items. Nothing shows it specifically recognizes or prioritizes government or legal mail. Missing for 10: explicit detection or flagging of IRS, state, and service-of-process mail; priority alerts or notifications for compliance-critical items; deadline-aware surfacing; independent or hands-on corroboration that labels catch such mail.
